title: Full of mistakes
description: The Boss asks Bob to bring Sandra to his office. He finds that Sandra's typed letter is full of mistakes - she typed 'intelligent' with only one 'L'. The Boss gives her a dictionary as a present. The lesson covers 'want/tell + object + to + verb' constructions.
answer_note: Practice A (dialogue fill-in) and Practice B (vocabulary) answers are from the workbook answer key. Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Where's Sandra, Bob? I want her.
lines.translation: 鲍勃，桑德拉在哪儿？我要她。

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Do you want to speak to her?

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Yes, I do. I want her to come to my office. Tell her to come at once.
lines.translation: 是的，我想。我要她到办公室来。叫她马上来。

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: Did you want to see me?

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: Ah, yes, Sandra. How do you spell 'intelligent'? Can you tell me?
lines.translation: 啊，是的，桑德拉。'intelligent'怎么拼？你能告诉我吗？

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: That's right. You've typed it with only one 'L'. This letter's full of mistakes. I want you to type it again.
lines.translation: 是的。但你只打了一个'L'。这封信错误百出。我要你重打一遍。

lines.speaker: Sandra
lines.text: Yes, I'll do that. I'm sorry about that.
lines.translation: 是的，我会的。对此我很抱歉。

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: And here's a little present for you.
lines.translation: 这儿有一个小礼物给你。

lines.speaker: The Boss
lines.text: It's a dictionary. I hope it'll help you.
lines.translation: 是一本词典。我希望它能帮到你。

items.title: Do you want to speak to her?
items.text: 在这句话中，to speak是动词want的宾语，而这个结构——动词原形前加to——在英文中被称为动词不定式。本课用动词不定式作宾语的例句还有：I want her to come to my office; Tell her to come at once; Did you want to see me; I want you to type it again等。

items.title: And here's ...
items.text: 这里and表示承上启下，使上下文紧密联系，当'于是'、'因此'讲。

practice.context: Choose the correct word from each pair to complete the sentence.

I think that girl's clever. - I don't. I think she's ___. (intelligent / stupid)

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite with 'want/tell + object + to + verb'
grammar.instruction: Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the examples. Example: Close all the doors. (he/want/her) → He wants her to close all the doors. Sweep the floor. (tell/her) → Tell her to sweep the floor.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：关上所有的门。（他/想要/她）→ 他想要她关上所有的门。扫地板。（叫/她）→ 叫她扫地板。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 105 I, PDF p.535-536)
grammar.context: Rewrite each imperative sentence using 'want/tell + object + to + verb'. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.

questions.answer: He wants her to close all the doors.
Tell her to sweep the floor.
I want him to put away the magazines.
She wants me to shut all the windows.

questions.prompt: Take out your pens and pencils. (tell/them)
questions.answer: Tell them to take out their pens and pencils.
He wants me to give him the newspaper.
Tell them to open their books.
Tell her to bring it to me.
She wants you to be careful.
I want you to read it to me.
She wants him to have a drink.
He wants you to turn on the lights.
Tell him to turn off the cooker.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Rewrite with 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'
grammar.instruction: Rewrite the sentences, using the words given according to the examples. Example: Don't stop. (tell/them) → Tell them not to stop. Don't swim in the river. (I/not want/you) → I don't want you to swim in the river.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词改写下列句子。例句：不要停。（叫/他们）→ 叫他们不要停。不要在河里游泳。（我/不想/你）→ 我不想要你在河里游泳。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 105 II, PDF p.536)
grammar.context: Rewrite each negative imperative sentence using 'tell/want + object + not to + verb'. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.

questions.prompt: Don't swim in the river. (I/not want/you)
questions.answer: I don't want you to swim in the river.
Tell him not to be lazy.
Tell her not to forget the telephone number.
He doesn't want you to be late.
He doesn't want us to wait for him.
She doesn't want him to open the window.
She doesn't want you to break the vase.
Tell him not to drive too fast.
Tell them not to lose the money.
Tell her not to hurt herself.
He doesn't want them to miss their train.
Tell him not to cut himself.
He doesn't want you to use a pencil.

questions.prompt: Don't paint the door yellow. (she/not want/him)
questions.answer: She doesn't want him to paint the door yellow.
